title: Opaque node
description: A captured setting that cannot be represented as JSON data: a closure, permission callback, computed option, or other callback. It points at its source location and is owned by people; streams:make never rewrites it.

handle.description: The dot path of the setting inside its node (columns.status.color).

file.description: The source file the callback came from, relative to the app root.

line.description: The line in the source file where the callback starts.
